31 ARTISTS AND COUNTING

Meet the artists.

FOLK / INDIE POP

Baek A ↗

백아

Photo: POCLANOS

Baek A writes songs with a poet’s attention to images and small changes in language. In “Amor”, memories of first love take the shape of a film, a night sky and stars drawn together.

A SONG TO START WITHAmorLive performance

JAZZ / CROSSOVER

Black String ↗

블랙스트링

Black String brings Korean traditional instruments, electric guitar and electronics together through improvisation. Geomungo player Yoon Jeong Heo leads the quartet.

A SONG TO START WITHMask DanceLive performance

POP

BOL4 ↗

볼빨간사춘기

BOL4 is the pop project of singer-songwriter Ahn Ji-young. Her songs are about falling in love, growing up and growing apart.

A SONG TO START WITHEternal loveLive performance

BALLAD

Car, the garden ↗

카더가든

Photo: CAM WITH US

Car, the garden is a singer-songwriter whose music brings together rock, pop and R&B. His stage name is a playful translation of his Korean name, Cha Jung-won.

A SONG TO START WITHTreeLive performance

FOLK

Choi Yu Ree ↗

최유리

Choi Yu Ree writes warm, reflective folk songs about everyday feelings. In “Forest”, she finds an image for belonging in trees growing together.

A SONG TO START WITHForestLive performance

INDIE ROCK

Danpyunsun and the Moments Ensemble ↗

단편선 순간들

Danpyunsun and the Moments Ensemble brings songwriter and producer Danpyunsun together with players on piano, bass, drums and guitar. The album notes for Hail to the Music describe wanting to capture the time in which people watch, feel and respond to one another.

A SONG TO START WITHYou, Me and NamyangjuOfficial audio

INDIE ROCK

ESEGYE ↗

이세계

ESEGYE is a Korean band writing about feelings people often keep to themselves. Their name points to another world.

A SONG TO START WITHRomanceYouthLoveLive performance

INDIE ROCK

gongwon ↗

공원

gongwon’s “Flower” follows someone who wants to keep growing, even when they dislike what they see in themselves. It appears on the EP 0, also featured in the live session below.

A SONG TO START WITHFlowerOfficial audio

ROCK

HANRORO ↗

한로로

HANRORO writes rock songs about growing up, with all its hopes and uncertainty. Her words reach out to people going through something similar.

A SONG TO START WITHEven if you leaveOfficial audio

FOLK

JEONGMILLA ↗

정밀아

JEONGMILLA is a folk singer-songwriter who writes about her life by paying attention to the places around her. On CheongPa Sonata, that means the streets, neighbours and public squares within walking distance of home.

A SONG TO START WITHDeparting from Seoul StationOfficial music video

FOLK

Kang Asol ↗

강아솔

Kang Asol is a singer-songwriter whose songs explore loneliness, self-doubt and the wish to keep loving. She writes about feelings that reassurance does not always reach.

A SONG TO START WITHIslandOfficial audio

FOLK

Kim Sawol ↗

김사월

Kim Sawol is a folk singer-songwriter whose songs look closely at love, loneliness and the contradictions of everyday life.

A SONG TO START WITHSomeoneOfficial music video

INDIE ROCK

Lacuna ↗

라쿠나

Lacuna use imagined worlds and fairy-tale storytelling to write about lonely people and outsiders. Their name comes from the memory-erasing company in Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind.

A SONG TO START WITHDancing in the RainLive performance

FOLK

Lang Lee ↗

이랑

Lang Lee writes songs about poverty, loss and the lives of people around her. Her collaborations with Unnie Choir bring a collective voice to songs about exclusion and separation.

A SONG TO START WITHThere is A WolfLive performance

INDIE ROCK

Meaningful Stone ↗

김뜻돌

Meaningful Stone (김뜻돌) writes songs from remembered dreams and personal relationships. In a Genie interview, she described wanting to record the atmosphere that lingered between dreams and waking life.

A SONG TO START WITHBeep-Boop, Beep-BoopLive performance

INDIE ROCK / POP

moneto ↗

모네토

moneto and MRCH meet in “She”, an English-language song about absence and the memories someone hopes to keep. He wrote the lyrics, co-composed the song with MRCH and played its guitars, synth and bass.

A SONG TO START WITHShe (Feat. MRCH)Live performance

POP / OST

Motte ↗

모트

Motte writes about uncertain relationships and the memories they leave behind. Her song “Don’t run away” also appears in the Korean web drama A-TEEN.

A SONG TO START WITHDon’t run awayOfficial audio

POP ROCK

MRCH ↗

윤마치 · 마치

MRCH raises a white flag in “Surrender”: even an alarm clock or a late-night message can feel like another battle. The singer-songwriter, also known as Yoon March, sings on moneto’s “She” and has her own songs to share here.

A SONG TO START WITHSurrenderLive performance

ALTERNATIVE ROCK

OHCHILL ↗

오칠

OHCHILL (오칠) is a Seoul rock duo pairing Junhong Yun’s guitar with Seol Kim’s drums, with both members contributing vocals.

A SONG TO START WITHSomething's WrongLive performance

INDIE ROCK

Say Sue Me ↗

세이수미

Say Sue Me are an indie rock band from Busan, where their rehearsal and recording space sits a short walk from Gwangalli Beach. Vocalist and guitarist Sumi Choi writes lyrics in both English and Korean.

A SONG TO START WITHOld TownLive performance

새소년

Hwang Soyoon’s voice and guitar are at the centre of SE SO NEON’s mix of blues, psychedelic rock and pop.

Silica Gel ↗

실리카겔

Silica Gel is a four-piece band with two vocalists: guitarist Kim Chunchu and keyboardist Kim Hanjoo, joined by drummer Kim Geonjay and bassist Choi Woonghee.

Sondia ↗

손디아

Sondia sings “Grown Ups” for My Mister, a song about feeling out of step with the people around you. The drama’s official OST video brings her voice back to its characters and their everyday lives.

YdBB ↗

예빛
